record.question:
Consider the following technologies:
     1. Green Hydrogen
     2. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
     3. Pumped Storage Hydropower
     4. Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS)
    Which of the above can directly contribute to India’s objective of achieving net-zero emissions?
